notes: ACCESS: Tier (a) direct HTTP only - curl_cffi impersonate=chrome for all pages (robots.txt is the generic Shopify agent policy, User-agent: * / Allow: /, no anthropic/Claude-specific disallow; site is fully HTTP-fetchable, no Playwright/Chrome needed). TREE: built from union of mega-menu (5 depth-2 parents under 'Shop': Furniture, Lighting, Decor, Soft Furnishings, Collections, each expanded via their navmenu-depth-3 submenus) plus the homepage 'shop by category' icon strip (Lights, Furniture, Home Linen/Cushion Covers, Carpets & Rugs, Artefacts & Collectibles, Tableware, Art & Wall Decor) plus /collections.json (95 total collection handles) used to sanity-check for orphans. /collections.json contains many non-nav handles (e.g. wooden-laundry-basket, wooden-bench, cane-chair, tax-18, *-2026-back-order, test-collection) that are not linked from any navigation surface - these are SEO/ad-landing or admin housekeeping collections, not genuine category pages, so they were excluded per the 'follow actual website navigation' rule. 'Collections' nav parent (Christmas Decor, Festive Gifting, Fibre Fables, Get Gifting, Indian Accent, Sustainable Design) is seasonal/promotional and excluded per rule. Every candidate collection's h1/canonical was checked against the requested handle and matched in all cases. QTY: this theme has no visible 'N products' header (Ajaxinate infinite-scroll theme); used /collections/<handle>/products.json?limit=250 as the deterministic count (confirmed exact by checking page=2 returns 0 products for every collection used, and by matching the handle set of the first rendered page (.productgrid--item, 48/page) as a strict subset of the products.json list). Per-page filter facets (?filter.p.product_type=...) exist but were treated as filter/search views, not standalone category URLs, per the View-All/filter exclusion rule - not recorded as separate rows. EXCLUDED: Furniture (Tables, Chairs & Stools, Bench, Sofa) and Lighting (Pendant/Wall/Table/Floor Lamps, Chandeliers, Bulbs) - out of scope categories. 'Storage & Cabinets' (/collections/storage-cabinets, 140 products) is explicitly nested under the Furniture nav parent and its own product_type facets are dominated by Cabinet(81)/Cabinets(30)/Sideboards(7)/Console(1)/Chest Box(3) - genuine storage furniture - so per storage.md Sec 21/27 (explicit Furniture-category placement is preferred absent strong contrary evidence) it was classified as Furniture and excluded from storage_rows, not duplicated here. 'Art & Wall Decor' (/collections/art-wall-decor) product_type facets are Paintings/Mirrors/Frames/Sculptures/Wall Decor - no tapestry/fabric-wall-hanging product types present - correctly excluded from Textile. 'View All Furnishing' (/collections/furnishing-2, H1 'Furnishing') is an aggregate view-all page spanning Cushion Covers, Carpets & Rugs, Coffee/Console/Dining Tables, Chairs, Mirrors, Pots and Storage Boxes together - excluded as a View-All/aggregate page per rule, its two genuine leaf sources (Home Linen, Carpets & Rugs) are already captured individually. No bedding, curtains, kitchen textiles, bathroom textiles, closet/laundry/shoe/toy/office storage categories exist on this small boutique site.
